articles.title: Hochschild Cocycle and Universality of Merge
articles.abstract: The Hopf algebra Markov chain dynamical system, on the Hopf algebra of non-planar binary forests, that models the action of Merge on workspaces in Chomsky's Minimalist Model of syntax, satisfies a universal property, determined by the fact that the Merge operation is a Hochschild 1-cocycle. This universal property has an interpretation in terms of models of the syntax-semantics interface, as it shows that, if the side of semantics possesses a sufficiently rich compositional structure, then that structure is uniquely induced by the syntactic Merge, once the semantic values of lexical items and syntactic features are assigned. We illustrate how this universality works by showing, in particular, full compatibility of this Hopf algebraic formulation with Heim-Kratzer semantics.
articles.titleCn: 高斯贝尔德循环与合并的普遍性
articles.abstractCn: 在非平面二元森林的Hopf代数上的Hopf代数马尔可夫链动力系统，该系统模拟了Chomsky最小主义语法模型中Merge操作对工作空间的作用，满足一个普遍性质，这个普遍性质由Merge操作是Hochschild 1-同态的事实所决定。这个普遍性质在语法-语义接口的模型中有解释，因为它表明，如果语义方面具有足够丰富的组合结构，那么这种结构将唯一地由句法的Merge所诱导，一旦词汇项和句法特征的语义值被分配。我们通过展示Hopf代数表述与Heim-Kratzer语义的完全兼容性，来说明这种普遍性是如何运作的。

articles.title: Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Objective: Hospital care prices in the United States have increased substantially, yet patients lack effective tools to access and compare costs. We aimed to develop and evaluate an LLM-based approach for improving access to and use of hospital price transparency (PT) data. Materials and Methods: To estimate visit prices, we used a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework to analyze PT files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region. We compared BM25, OpenAI embedding models, and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline for cost estimation of individual procedures and procedure groups, then evaluated the best approach for symptom-based visit cost estimation using synthetic simulations. Results: Across hospitals, the GPT-BM25 retriever achieved the best performance, with average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, compared with 147.98% and 82.82%, respectively, for the no-RAG baseline. In simulations, our framework correctly identified approximately 50% of reference procedures and reduced MAPE relative to the LLM-only baseline at two of the three hospitals, while achieving comparable performance at the third. Discussion: Our framework uses RAG to improve care price estimation in real-world settings. Compared with the no-RAG baseline, it substantially improved cost estimates for both individual procedures and procedure groups. Improvements were smaller in synthetic simulations, likely because inferring procedures from clinical information is more complex. Practical challenges remain, including heterogeneous PT file formats, unexplained duplicate entries, and limited availability of insurer-negotiated rates. Conclusion: LLMs that effectively integrate PT data show strong potential to provide patients with more accessible and accurate healthcare cost estimates.
articles.titleCn: 利用大型语言模型从医院价格透明数据中估算门诊费用
articles.abstractCn: 目标：美国医院的护理费用大幅增加，但患者缺乏有效工具来获取和比较成本。我们旨在开发并评估一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法，以改善医院价格透明度（PT）数据的获取和使用。材料与方法：为估算就诊费用，我们使用检索增强生成（RAG）框架分析马里兰州三家主要医院及其周边地区的PT文件。我们比较了BM25、OpenAI嵌入模型以及GPT-BM25混合模型与无RAG基线的个体手术和手术组成本估算，然后使用合成模拟评估最佳方法用于基于症状的就诊成本估算。结果：在所有医院中，GPT-BM25检索器表现最佳，个体手术的平均价格MAPE为19.44%，手术组为4.90%，而无RAG基线分别为147.98%和82.82%。在模拟中，我们的框架正确识别了约50%的参考手术，在三家医院中的两家相对于仅使用LLM的基线降低了MAPE，同时在第三家医院实现了相当的性能。讨论：我们的框架使用RAG来改善现实世界环境中的护理价格估算。与无RAG基线相比，它显著提高了个体手术和手术组的成本估算。在合成模拟中，改进较小，可能因为从临床信息中推断手术更为复杂。仍然存在实际挑战，包括异构PT文件格式、未解释的重复条目以及保险公司谈判费率的有限可用性。结论：能够有效整合PT数据的LLM显示出为患者提供更易于获取和更准确的医疗费用估算的强大潜力。

articles.title: FIDEL: Abugida-Aware Pre-tokenization for Ethiopic Languages
articles.abstract: Subword tokenizers assume that meaningful linguistic units can be recovered by splitting text at learned boundaries, an assumption better suited to concatenative morphology than to Semitic root-and-pattern systems. The challenge is acute for the Ethiopic languages, whose abugida script encodes consonant-vowel units as single characters and hides consonantal structure. We introduce FIDEL (FIdäl DEcomposition and Linearization), a family of reversible abugida-aware pre-tokenization schemes that expose consonant and vowel-order structure, extend SPLINTER reductions from abjad scripts to the Ethiopic abugida, and evaluate them on three Ethiopic languages under controlled conditions, holding corpus, architecture, budget and protocol fixed so that tokenization is the only variable. We report intrinsic tokenizer statistics for BPE and UnigramLM across vocabulary sizes alongside downstream NLP tasks, including transfer scenarios. We find that FIDEL reduction improves news classification consistently and named-entity recognition at larger capacity, while sentiment analysis performance declines under the more aggressive schemes, and extractive question answering performance is preserved.
articles.titleCn: FIDEL：针对埃塞俄比亚语言的字素感知预分词
articles.abstractCn: 子词分词器假设通过在学习的边界处分割文本可以恢复有意义的语言单位，这一假设更适合连接形态学而非闪米特语系中的根与模式系统。对于埃塞俄比亚语言来说，这一挑战尤为突出，因为其阿布吉达文字将辅音-元音单位编码为单个字符，并隐藏了辅音结构。我们介绍了FIDEL（FIdäl DEcomposition and Linearization），这是一系列可逆的、感知阿布吉达文字的预分词方案，它们揭示了辅音和元音顺序结构，将SPLINTER简化规则从阿贾德文字扩展到埃塞俄比亚阿布吉达文字，并在受控条件下对三种埃塞俄比亚语言进行评估，保持语料库、架构、预算和协议不变，使分词成为唯一变量。我们报告了BPE和UnigramLM在不同词汇量下的内在分词器统计数据，以及下游NLP任务，包括迁移场景。我们发现，FIDEL简化规则始终提高了新闻分类的性能，并在较大容量下提升了命名实体识别，但在更激进的方案下，情感分析性能下降，而抽取式问答性能得以保持。

articles.title: Do We Still Need Fine-Tuned Classifiers? Swapping Typed Decision Models into 24 ACL-Venue Papers
articles.abstract: Typed Decision Models such as TypeSafe's Jev, also called System One or System 1 models, answer typed questions about an input with a probability for each option, and they need no training. Many NLP papers still fine-tune a task-specific classifier, and prompted large language models (LLMs) trail such classifiers on most text classification benchmarks. We ask how many of these fine-tuned classifiers a Typed Decision Model can replace under each paper's own evaluation, and what is needed where it cannot. We swap the predictors of 24 ACL-venue papers for Jev, keep each paper's splits, label definitions and metric, and check the results with Cloudflare's Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Decisions. The resulting 46 English test sets, with their questions and published scores, form the TDM-Gauntlet benchmark. With a zero-shot prompt, Jev directly replaced the paper's predictor on 12 of the 46 test sets, mostly single judgments with plain labels, but rarely where the paper's method was trained on its labels. Where Jev scored lower, we most often attributed the shortfall to an annotation convention that the label name does not state. With 500 training labels plus validation and no user-managed GPU, calibration and GEPA-style prompt optimization closed a median 72% of the gap to the paper's method, about twice what off-the-shelf GEPA closed, for a median $1.66 per search. On the same labels, fine-tuned encoders such as RoBERTa and DeBERTa closed 59%, and LoRA fine-tuning of the open LLM Qwen3.8-27B closed 97%. Fine-tuning remains the most accurate option, but a zero-shot prompt is often enough for plain labels, and prompt optimization closes most of the remaining gap.
articles.titleCn: 我们是否还需要微调分类器？将类型化决策模型替换进24篇ACL-Venue论文
articles.abstractCn: 类型化决策模型（如TypeSafe的Jev，也称为系统一或系统1模型）通过概率为每个选项回答输入中的类型化问题，并且无需训练。许多自然语言处理论文仍然对特定任务的分类器进行微调，而提示式大型语言模型（LLM）在大多数文本分类基准测试中落后于这些分类器。我们询问在每篇论文自己的评估下，类型化决策模型可以替代多少个这些微调分类器，以及它无法做到的地方需要什么。我们将24篇ACL会议论文的预测器替换为Jev，保留每篇论文的分割、标签定义和指标，并使用Cloudflare的Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1和OpenAI的GPT-6 Luna Decisions检查结果。由此产生的46个英语测试集，包括其问题和已发表的分数，形成了TDM-Gauntlet基准。通过零样本提示，Jev直接替换了46个测试集中的12个论文预测器，主要是带有简单标签的单判断，但很少是论文方法在其标签上训练的地方。在Jev得分较低的情况下，我们通常将差距归因于一个标注惯例，即标签名称没有说明。使用500个训练标签加上验证，并且没有用户管理的GPU，校准和GEPA风格的提示优化缩小了与论文方法的中位数72%的差距，大约是现成GEPA的两倍，每项搜索中位数1.66美元。在相同的标签上，微调编码器如RoBERTa和DeBERTa缩小了59%，而开放LLM Qwen3.8-27B的LoRA微调缩小了97%。微调仍然是最高准确度的选项，但零样本提示通常足以处理简单标签，而提示优化可以缩小大部分剩余差距。

articles.title: Who Can You Hide Behind? Author-Conditioned Style Transfer and the Evasion of a Commercial AI-Text Detector
articles.abstract: AI-text detectors can be sensitive to changes in writing style. We examined this sensitivity by rewriting 991 AI-generated answers with Gemini, using prompts that included a writing sample from one of 55 named authors. We scored each original and its rewrite with the QuillBot AI detector. The median score fell from 100% to 0%, and the mean fell from 67.9% to 11.2%. Of the rewrites, 66% received a score of exactly 0%. Among the 699 originals scored at least 50%, 71% of rewrites scored below 10% (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p-value below 1e-100). Scores varied across the authors used in the prompts. All rewrites associated with 10 authors scored 0%, whereas the mean score remained above 50% for six authors (Kruskal-Wallis test, p-value below 1e-80). Greater reuse of five-word sequences from the author sample was associated with lower scores, although rewrites with less than 5% reuse still averaged 15.2%. These results describe one detector and one rewriting system, not detectors in general. The study lacks a generic-rewrite baseline, did not measure preservation of meaning, and produced rewrites that were substantially longer than the originals.
articles.titleCn: 谁是你可以躲藏的？作者条件风格迁移和商业AI文本检测的规避
articles.abstractCn: AI文本检测器对写作风格的改变可能很敏感。我们通过使用Gemini重写991个AI生成的答案，并使用包含55位知名作家中的一位写作样本的提示来检验这种敏感性。我们使用QuillBot AI检测器对每个原始文本及其重写进行评分。中位数分数从100%降至0%，平均分从67.9%降至11.2%。在重写中，66%的文本获得了0分的评分。在至少获得50%评分的699个原始文本中，71%的重写得分低于10%（配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p值低于1e-100）。评分在不同提示中使用的作家之间有所差异。与10位作家的重写相关联的分数均为0%，而六位作家的平均分仍保持在50%以上（Kruskal-Wallis检验，p值低于1e-80）。作者样本中五词序列的更大重复使用与较低分数相关，尽管重复使用率低于5%的重写平均得分为15.2%。这些结果描述的是一种检测器和一种重写系统，而不是通用的检测器。该研究缺乏通用重写基线，没有测量意义的保留，并且产生的重写文本显著长于原始文本。

articles.title: Risk-certified prompt optimization for LLM-as-a-judge guardrails
articles.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge guardrails are often controlled primarily through system prompts, yet standard prompt optimization methods target average performance rather than explicit safety constraints. This paper studies system-prompt selection as a constrained optimization problem: maximize benign pass rate while keeping the missed-attack rate below a user-specified level α with finite-sample statistical control. The framework combines LLM-based judging, automatic prompt generation, and distribution-free risk certification. This work instantiates it in two procedures: CPS and CRISP. CPS generates a fixed pool of prompts from training data, then certifies candidates on a held-out evaluation set using simultaneous upper confidence bounds and selects the certified prompt with the highest benign utility. CRISP instead integrates risk feedback into an adaptive search, using hard example-guided rewriting and a reusable-holdout interface to steer generation toward the feasible utility frontier. Experiments on four datasets covering prompt injection, system-prompt leakage, and sensitive-information disclosure show that risk-certified selection consistently respects the target missed-attack level on heldout tests, while utility improves as the permitted risk is relaxed. CRISP is especially useful when fixed-pool search fails to produce certifiable high-utility candidates.
articles.titleCn: 基于风险认证的提示优化用于LLM作为裁判的护栏
articles.abstractCn: LLM作为裁判的约束条件通常主要通过系统提示进行控制，然而标准的提示优化方法针对的是平均性能而非明确的安全约束。本文将系统提示选择研究为一个约束优化问题：在有限样本统计控制下，最大化良性通过率，同时将遗漏攻击率保持在用户指定的水平α以下。该框架结合了基于LLM的评判、自动提示生成和分布无关的风险认证。这项工作通过两种程序实例化了该框架：CPS和CRISP。CPS从训练数据中生成一组固定的提示池，然后在保留的评估集上使用同时上置信界限对候选提示进行认证，并选择具有最高良性效用的认证提示。CRISP则将风险反馈集成到自适应搜索中，利用硬示例引导重写和可重用保留接口来引导生成朝向可行效用前沿。在涵盖提示注入、系统提示泄露和敏感信息泄露的四个数据集上的实验表明，风险认证选择在保留测试中始终尊重目标遗漏攻击水平，而效用随着允许风险的放宽而提高。当固定池搜索无法产生可认证的高效用候选提示时，CRISP尤其有用。

articles.title: Centered Ablation: Why Last-Layer Directional Ablation Under-Fires or Collapses, and a Closed-Form Fix
articles.abstract: Directional ablation removes a hidden state's component along a "behaviour direction" while a language model runs. It is the standard way to switch a behaviour such as refusal off, but it is erratic: on some models it barely fires, on others the text collapses into repetition. We show why, and fix it. At the last residual stream, ablation is exactly a logit bias: a fixed vocabulary footprint scaled by a gate, the cosine between the hidden state and the direction. The gate is measured from the origin, but last-layer states share a large common mode far from it, so a direction that overlaps the common mode fires on benign text and under-fires on its targets. Centered Ablation (CA) projects the common mode out of the direction, in closed form. Across 8 models, CA raises attack success by 29 and 46 points where the standard recipe under-fires, cuts collapse on Gemma-2-9B from 50\% to 1\%, and preserves 12 to 40 points more benign answers on high-overlap models, 39 to 46 more than the affine offset of prior work. Two numbers computed before generation predict, on models the analysis had not seen, which gain faithfulness and which gain attack success, and a collapse index marks when text degenerates. We also show that two standard safety judges score collapsed text in opposite directions, which can fabricate a 46-point effect.
articles.titleCn: 中心消融：为何最后一层定向消融会不足或崩溃，以及一种封闭形式修正方法
articles.abstractCn: 方向性消融在语言模型运行时移除隐藏状态的某个分量，这是关闭拒绝等行为的标准方法，但它效果不稳定：在某些模型上几乎不起作用，在另一些模型上文本会陷入重复。我们揭示了原因并解决了这个问题。在最后一个残差流中，消融本质上是一个逻辑偏置：一个固定词汇足迹乘以一个门控值，即隐藏状态与方向之间的余弦值。门控值是从原点测量的，但最后一层状态共享一个远离原点的巨大公共模式，因此与公共模式重叠的方向会在良性文本上触发，而在目标文本上触发不足。中心消融（CA）将公共模式从方向中投影出去，以封闭形式实现。在8个模型上，CA在标准方法触发不足的情况下提高了29%和46%的攻击成功率，将Gemma-2-9B的崩溃率从50%降至1%，并在高重叠模型上保留了12%至40%更多的良性答案，比先前工作的仿射偏置多出39%至46%。在生成前计算的两组数字可以预测分析中未见过的模型哪些会提高忠实度，哪些会提高攻击成功率，崩溃指数则标记文本何时退化。我们还表明，两个标准安全判别器对崩溃文本的评分方向相反，这可以伪造一个46分的效应。

articles.title: Rank, Don't Regress: A 279M Text Ranker Beats 2B and 7B VLMs on Referential Urdu GUI Grounding
articles.abstract: UI grounding asks a model to find the screen element that a user instruction refers to. Most current systems use a vision-language model (VLM) that reads a screenshot and outputs pixel coordinates. We study this task on Urdu mobile web pages, a setting with no published UI grounding results. Instead of regressing coordinates, we take the candidate elements from the page DOM and train a 279M-parameter cross-encoder (mDeBERTa-v3-base) to pick one. The click point is the centre of the picked element's box, so it is exact whenever the right element is picked. We built a frozen test set of 304 instructions from six Urdu news sites; 149 of them (49%) are referential and never quote the full target text. Test domains were banned from training data before collection started. The ranker scores 73.4% point-in-box accuracy, against 29.6% for UI-TARS-2B and 23.7% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both zero-shot. On the referential slice the ranker scores 65.8%, against 30.2% for a string-matching baseline that needs no training. In a controlled comparison at small scale, with training data drawn from the same pages, a coordinate-regression model of similar size scores 1.6%. Adding element geometry as input tokens gives the best variant, at 75.7%. The ranker's errors concentrate in two places: elements that share identical text, and ordinal instructions such as "the fourth link".
articles.titleCn: 排名，勿退步：一个2.79亿文本排序器在参考性乌尔都语GUI grounding任务上击败了20亿和70亿视觉语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 界面基础任务要求模型找出用户指令所指的屏幕元素。当前大多数系统使用视觉语言模型（VLM）读取屏幕截图并输出像素坐标。我们在乌尔都语移动网页上研究这项任务，这是一个没有公开界面基础结果的环境。我们不是回归坐标，而是从页面DOM中提取候选元素，并训练一个2.79亿参数的交叉编码器（mDeBERTa-v3-base）来选择其中一个。点击点是被选元素框的中心，因此只要选对了元素，它就是精确的。我们从六个乌尔都语新闻网站构建了一个冻结的测试集，包含304条指令；其中149条（49%）是指令性的，从未引用完整目标文本。测试域在收集数据前被排除在训练数据之外。排名器的点在框内准确率达到73.4%，而UI-TARS-2B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B（均为零样本）分别为29.6%和23.7%。在指令性子集上，排名器达到65.8%，而字符串匹配基线（无需训练）为30.2%。在小型受控比较中，使用来自相同页面的训练数据，类似规模的坐标回归模型得分仅为1.6%。添加元素几何形状作为输入标记的最佳变体达到了75.7%。排名器的错误集中在两个地方：文本完全相同的元素，以及序数字令，如“第四个链接”。

articles.title: HEAMS: Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems
articles.abstract: Memory systems allow AI agents to persist information across interactions, making them more personalized and more capable on long-horizon tasks. This persistence introduces new risks: stored information can be disclosed in inappropriate contexts, resist correction or deletion, be retained beyond what users desire, or be poisoned to influence later agent behaviour. Yet memory systems are typically evaluated on task performance and efficiency alone. We argue that a memory system should instead be understood as the custodian of its user's persistent information, with responsibilities that extend beyond helping an agent complete its tasks, and that it should be evaluated holistically against all such responsibilities. We present Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems (HEAMS), an open-source framework for evaluating agent memory systems in this way. First, we state the responsibilities of agent memory systems as explicit behavioural desiderata spanning performance, efficiency, security, privacy, and user sovereignty. Second, we assemble a benchmark suite that covers these desiderata and acknowledge the gaps that remain. Third, we develop MilaMem, a prototype memory system, and a governance layer that can wrap any memory system, enabling controlled study of memory system design choices. Fourth, we compare memory systems across the full HEAMS benchmark suite. We find that no memory system leads every performance benchmark, and strong performance scores may coexist with poor privacy, user-sovereignty, and security scores. Governance strongly influences results: recall policies can reduce inappropriate disclosure at a cost in helpfulness, while both recall and retention policies improve poisoning resistance. Performance and efficiency benchmarks alone therefore cannot reveal how well a memory system meets its responsibilities. Code: https://github.com/milatechtransfer/heams

articles.titleCn: HEAMS：智能体记忆系统整体评估
articles.abstractCn: 记忆系统允许AI代理在交互之间持久化信息，使其更具个性化，并在长时程任务中表现更出色。这种持久性带来了新的风险：存储的信息可能在不适当的情境下被泄露，难以纠正或删除，被保留超出用户期望的时间，或被污染以影响后续代理行为。然而，记忆系统通常仅根据任务性能和效率进行评估。我们认为，记忆系统应被视为其用户持久信息的保管者，其责任应超越帮助代理完成任务，并应就所有这些责任进行整体评估。我们提出了整体评估代理记忆系统（HEAMS），这是一个开源框架，用于以这种方式评估代理记忆系统。首先，我们将代理记忆系统的责任陈述为涵盖性能、效率、安全、隐私和用户主权的明确行为期望。其次，我们汇编了一个基准套件，涵盖这些期望，并承认仍然存在的差距。第三，我们开发了MilaMem，一个原型记忆系统，以及一个治理层，可以封装任何记忆系统，实现记忆系统设计选择的受控研究。第四，我们在完整的HEAMS基准套件中比较了不同的记忆系统。我们发现没有哪个记忆系统在所有性能基准中都领先，并且强劲的性能得分可能与糟糕的隐私、用户主权和安全得分并存。治理对结果有显著影响：召回策略可以减少不适当的泄露，但会牺牲帮助性；召回和保留策略都能提高抗污染能力。因此，仅根据性能和效率基准无法揭示记忆系统是否履行了其责任。代码：https://github.com/milatechtransfer/heams

articles.title: Can AI Judge You? An Empirical Audit of Deployment Readiness in LLM-assisted Hiring Systems
articles.abstract: Delegating resume screening to large language models (LLMs) requires organizations to establish whether they can distinguish candidates by relevant qualifications while allowing only authorized users to change screening rules or approve exceptions. To this end, we develop a system architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment record, and empirically examine two complementary dimensions of its deployment readiness. First, we assess its operational readiness on four LLMs using a controlled experiment on 210 resumes across 14 job roles and six decision interfaces. Second, we assess its compliance readiness by testing how it handles unauthorized user requests and instructions embedded in resumes. We find that operational performance depends on the choice of evaluation interface: scalar scores generally distinguish qualification changes better than simple pass/fail judgments, while comparative judgments are sensitive to presentation order. Explicit permission rules and separation of resume content from instructions reduce unauthorized compliance, to a varying degree of effectiveness across LLMs and usage contexts. Finally, we find that LLM evaluators often diverge between their decisions and offered justifications. Going beyond simply evaluating LLMs for hiring tasks, our framework supports an audit of a fully configured resume evaluation system to enable its deployment decision.
articles.titleCn: AI能评判你吗？对LLM辅助招聘系统部署准备状况的实证审计
articles.abstractCn: 将简历筛选工作委托给大型语言模型（LLM）需要组织建立一套机制，以判断模型能否根据相关资质区分候选人，同时仅允许授权用户修改筛选规则或批准例外情况。为此，我们开发了一种系统架构，将候选人证据、评估过程、权限控制和评估记录进行分离，并通过实证研究考察其部署准备情况的两个互补维度。首先，我们通过在14个职位角色和6个决策界面的210份简历上进行的受控实验，评估该系统在四个LLM上的操作准备情况。其次，我们通过测试系统如何处理简历中嵌入的非授权用户请求和指令，评估其合规准备情况。我们发现，操作性能取决于评估界面的选择：标量评分通常比简单的通过/失败判断更能区分资质变化，而比较性判断对呈现顺序敏感。明确的权限规则以及将简历内容与指令分离，可不同程度地减少非授权合规行为，效果因LLM和使用场景而异。最后，我们发现LLM评估者在其决策和提供的理由之间往往存在分歧。超越仅对LLM进行招聘任务评估，我们的框架支持对完全配置好的简历评估系统进行审计，以支持其部署决策。

articles.title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes
articles.abstract: Decision models are a new class of language model that, instead of generating text, choose one option per question from a fixed list and return a probability for every option. They have not yet been evaluated on clinical text. We evaluated two open-weights decision models, Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B, for extracting 25 fields from 1,113 oral cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database. We compared them with two generative models: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, and GLM-5.3-flash, run through a cloud API. Tev1 reached a mean field accuracy of 0.917 (95% CI 0.913 to 0.920), the same as Qwen3.5 9B (0.918; p = 0.26), and was four times faster (15 s against 61 s per report). Nimble reached 0.862 and GLM-5.3-flash 0.986. Both decision models matched GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous categories. They were weak on measurements binned into categories, on fields whose correct answer was not reported, and on some complex decisions (e.g. involved margins). We found that the main cause of the inferior performance of Nimble's came from asking 25 questions in one request: with two questions per request, its accuracy improved. Pooled over fields, the returned probabilities were well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.022 and 0.026), but they did not flag systematic errors within single fields. A simulated strategy of sending answers with a probability below 0.94 to GLM-5.3-flash raised Tev1's accuracy to 0.982, with 38% of answers escalated. Decision models can extract explicitly stated findings from pathology reports quickly on local hardware and return useful probabilities. They should be validated in the configuration in which they will be used, restricted to the fields in which they are reliable, and combined with other methods for numeric values.
articles.titleCn: 决策模型能否从癌症病理报告中提取临床数据？一项关于准确性、校准度和失效模式的评估
articles.abstractCn: 决策模型是一种新型的语言模型，它不生成文本，而是从固定列表中选择每个问题的选项，并为每个选项返回概率。它们尚未在临床文本中进行评估。我们评估了两个开源权重决策模型——Nimble 9B 和 Tev1 4B，用于从单个中心提取 1,113 份口腔癌病理报告中的 25 个字段，并与前瞻性维护的临床数据库进行对比。我们将它们与两个生成模型进行了比较：本地运行的 Qwen3.5 9B 和通过云 API 运行的 GLM-5.3-flash。Tev1 达到了平均字段准确率 0.917（95% CI 0.913 至 0.920），与 Qwen3.5 9B（0.918；p = 0.26）相同，且速度提高了四倍（每份报告 15 秒对比 61 秒）。Nimble 达到了 0.862，而 GLM-5.3-flash 达到了 0.986。两种决策模型在简单的二分类类别上与 GLM-5.3-flash 相匹配。它们在分类中的测量值、未报告正确答案的字段以及一些复杂决策（例如涉及边缘）方面表现较弱。我们发现 Nimble 性能较差的主要原因是每次请求中询问 25 个问题：每次请求两个问题后，其准确率有所提高。在所有字段中，返回的概率经过良好校准（预期校准误差为 0.022 和 0.026），但它们未能标记单个字段中的系统误差。模拟策略中，将概率低于 0.94 的答案发送给 GLM-5.3-flash，将 Tev1 的准确率提高到 0.982，其中 38% 的答案被升级。决策模型可以在本地硬件上快速从病理报告中提取明确陈述的发现，并返回有用的概率。它们应在实际使用配置中验证，仅限于可靠字段，并结合其他方法处理数值。

articles.title: A Corpus-Driven SentencePiece Unigram Tokenizer for Sindhi: Design and Benchmark Against Fourteen Existing Tokenizers
articles.abstract: Sindhi is a low-resource Indo-Aryan language written mainly in an extended Perso-Arabic script. Several Sindhi tokenizers have been released on public model hubs, but they have not been compared with one another on shared data. We train SentencePiece Unigram tokenizers with byte fallback at four vocabulary sizes (32k to 150k) on about 1.10 million Sindhi sentences and a smaller, repeated Urdu, Persian and Arabic slice, from four public sources, and compare them with fourteen existing tokenizers on four evaluation sets: FLORES+, Sindhi Wikipedia, a news-derived sentiment corpus, and a contemporary news corpus. The metrics are fertility, single-token retention, UNK rate, byte-fallback rate, and round-trip character loss. At 64k, our tokenizer averages 1.147 tokens per word, against 1.208 for the best existing tokenizer and 1.512 for XLM-RoBERTa, and keeps 88.6% of words as single tokens. On fertility, single-token retention and UNK rate it is best or tied for best in all four evaluation sets at 64k and above; at 32k it trails one baseline on FLORES+. Margins over the best Sindhi-adapted baselines are small (0.002 fertility on FLORES+ at 64k), and we report no significance tests. A round-trip check finds no character loss for our tokenizer and silent character deletion (up to 0.85% of characters) in two existing ones; seven others lose less than 0.1%. We evaluate intrinsic metrics only, so effects on downstream tasks remain untested. Code and tokenizer files are public (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23962474).

articles.titleCn: 基于语料库的Sindhi SentencePiece单语素分词器：设计与十四个现有分词器的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 信德语是一种低资源的印欧语系语言，主要使用扩展的波斯-阿拉伯文字书写。已在公共模型中心发布了几个信德语分词器，但它们在共享数据上并未相互比较。我们在约110万句信德语句子以及一个较小的、重复的乌尔都语、波斯语和阿拉伯语片段上，使用字节回退训练了四种词汇量的SentencePiece Unigram分词器（32k至150k），并使用四个公共数据源，将它们与现有的十四个分词器在四个评估集上进行比较：FLORES+、信德语维基百科、新闻来源的情感语料库以及当代新闻语料库。评估指标包括生育率、单词保留率、UNK率、字节回退率和往返字符损失率。在64k时，我们的分词器平均每个词1.147个词元，而现有最佳分词器为1.208，XLM-RoBERTa为1.512，并保留了88.6%的词为单个词元。在生育率、单词保留率和UNK率方面，它在64k及以上所有四个评估集中表现最佳或并列最佳；在32k时，它在FLORES+上落后于一个基线。与现有信德语适配基线的差距很小（在64k时，FLORES+上的生育率为0.002），我们没有报告显著性检验。往返检查发现，我们的分词器没有字符损失，而两个现有分词器存在静默字符删除（高达0.85%的字符）；其他七个分词器损失率低于0.1%。我们仅评估了内在指标，因此下游任务的影响尚未得到测试。代码和分词器文件已公开（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23962474）。

articles.title: FRAAC: A French Multimodal Large Language Model and Dataset forPictogram-Based Augmentative and Alternative Communication
articles.abstract: Pictograms are a core modality in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC), yet recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot reliably interpret or produce pictogram sequences. Two obstacles explain this gap: the absence of a standardized pictogram grammar and the scarcity of parallel text-pictogram data. We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Pictogram Selection (RAPS), an annotation method that refines a rule-based transcription system's output with LLM-based concept extraction and retrieval over a pictogram vocabulary, handling cases where hand-written rules fail (named entities, numbers, polysemous words) without requiring new rules. Applied to French, RAPS yields a synthetic corpus of 1.4 million parallel pairs, of which 300k are publicly released. In a human ranking study where annotators order four pictogram transcriptions of the same sentence, RAPS outperforms the rule-based state of the art. Moreover, we show that standard reference-based metrics separate systems of clearly different quality but fail to rank strong systems against each other. Finally, we build an instruction-tuned model that supports interaction in several AAC modalities: it accepts pictogram or text input and answers in pictograms, speech, or text.
articles.titleCn: FRAAC：一个基于法语的、多模态的大型语言模型和数据集，用于基于图标的辅助和替代性沟通
articles.abstractCn: 图标是辅助和替代沟通（AAC）的核心方式，但最新的多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）无法可靠地解释或生成图标序列。存在两个障碍解释了这一差距：缺乏标准化的图标语法以及平行文本-图标数据的稀缺。我们介绍了检索增强图标选择（RAPS），这是一种注释方法，通过基于LLM的概念提取和图标词汇库上的检索来改进基于规则的转录系统的输出，处理手写规则失效的情况（如命名实体、数字、多义词），而无需创建新规则。应用于法语，RAPS生成了一个包含140万对平行对的合成语料库，其中30万对已公开发布。在一个人类排序研究中，标注员需要对同一句子的四个图标转录进行排序，RAPS的表现优于基于规则的当前最佳技术。此外，我们展示了标准的基于参考的指标可以区分明显不同质量的系统，但无法对高性能系统进行排序。最后，我们构建了一个指令微调模型，支持在多种AAC模态中进行交互：它接受图标或文本输入，并以图标、语音或文本形式回答。

articles.title: The Silent Cost of Conversation History in LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn information systems accumulate their own earlier replies and a growing task state. We asked whether this conversation history lowers accuracy, and whether process-level quality metrics warn before it does. Each analysis was fixed before its outcomes were computed. In Study 1, on 48 sharded math tasks, retaining its replies lowered final success by 0.21 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.29 for Mistral-7B (Holm-adjusted p = 0.026 and 0.004); Llama-4 Scout showed the same direction, not significant. Study 2 introduces CDR-Stream, 100-turn state-tracking dialogues with an exact answer per turn and per-model difficulty calibration. With the full history, accuracy fell from about 0.6 to 0.1 within twenty turns at matched difficulty, whereas a solver-verified state summary kept it 0.52-0.59 higher (Holm-adjusted p less than 0.001). Consistency and logical coherence fell far less than accuracy, and stability rose. None of these metrics, a paired readiness measure or calibrated single-stream drift detectors gave robust, model-general early warning, although in Study 2 the repeat-based metrics were complete only for GPT-4o-mini. In the monitors we tested, a single 100-turn stream had power only for very large drops. Systems built on LLMs should keep task state outside the transcript and monitor across sessions.
articles.titleCn: LLM推理中对话历史的沉默成本
articles.abstractCn: 在多轮信息系统中，大型语言模型（LLMs）会积累它们自己的早期回复以及不断增长的任务状态。我们探讨了这种对话历史是否会导致准确率下降，以及过程级质量指标是否能在准确率下降前发出预警。每次分析在结果计算前都进行了固定设置。在研究1中，针对48个分片的数学任务，保留其回复使得GPT-4o-mini的最终成功率降低了0.21，Mistral-7B降低了0.29（Holm调整p值分别为0.026和0.004）；Llama-4 Scout显示出相同趋势，但结果不显著。研究2引入了CDR-Stream，这是一种100轮状态追踪对话，每轮都有确切答案，并对每款模型的难度进行了精确校准。在匹配难度下，完整历史记录使得准确率在20轮内从约0.6降至0.1，而经过求解器验证的状态摘要则使其提高了0.52-0.59（Holm调整p值小于0.001）。一致性和逻辑连贯性下降幅度远小于准确率，稳定性则上升。尽管如此，这些指标、配对的准备度指标或校准的单流漂移检测器均未给出稳健的、模型通用的早期预警，尽管在研究2中，基于重复的指标仅对GPT-4o-mini完整。在我们测试的监控器中，单个100轮流仅对非常大的下降具有效力。基于LLM构建的系统应将任务状态保持在文本之外，并在会话间进行监控。

articles.title: Mandarin Wh-Indefinites Follow Nonveridicality in Multilingual LLMs, Unlike English any
articles.abstract: Multilingual LLMs learn mostly from English. Do they carry English polarity licensing over to other languages? English any is licensed by downward-entailing (DE) contexts, Mandarin wh-indefinites such as shenme 'what/something' by nonveridical ones, and the two classes come apart: perhaps licenses shenme but not any, while only licenses any but entails existence. We test this dissociation in a pre-registered study of twelve open LLMs (0.5B-9B, four families), using 48 matched bilingual frames in 21 contexts and a log-probability difference-in-differences normalised by negation. All 11 models that pass the measurement gate license Mandarin wh-indefinites under possibility, necessity and evidential adverbs, at 0.42-2.33 times the strength of negation, while English any gets nothing in the same contexts. An exploratory extension to Qwen2.5-32B shows the same. The English side is weaker: any under only, first and regret is licensed but at a fraction of negation, so only 3 models show the full double dissociation in sentence probabilities. When prompted to choose between sentences, most gated models show it. In exploratory directional ablations, a direction that carries English licensing, held-out classes included, does not reach Mandarin licensing in most models. The models do not simply apply the English rule to Mandarin.
articles.titleCn: 与英语不同，多语言大型语言模型中的普通话Wh-不定式遵循非真实性。
articles.abstractCn: 多语言大型语言模型主要从英语中学习。它们会将英语极性许可迁移到其他语言吗？英语的any由向下蕴涵（DE）语境许可，普通话的shenme（什么/某物）等疑问不定词由非真实性语境许可，这两类语境存在差异：或许shenme被许可但any不被许可，而any被许可但蕴含存在性。我们在一项预先注册的研究中测试了这种分离现象，该研究考察了十二个开源大型语言模型（0.5B-9B，四个系列），使用了21种语境中的48个匹配双语框架，并以否定词为基准对对数概率差异进行标准化。所有通过测量门控的11个模型在可能性、必要性和证据性副词下都许可普通话疑问不定词，其许可强度为否定词的0.42-2.33倍，而英语的any在相同语境下未获得许可。对Qwen2.5-32B的探索性扩展显示结果相同。英语方面较弱：any在仅、首先和遗憾语境下被许可，但强度仅为否定词的一部分，因此只有3个模型在句子概率上表现出完整的双重分离。当提示模型选择句子时，大多数门控模型显示了这一现象。在探索性方向性消融实验中，一个携带英语许可的方向，包括被排除的类别，在大多数模型中未能达到普通话许可。模型并非简单地将英语规则应用于普通话。

articles.title: A Dataset for Misogyny Detection in Polish Social Media: Transferability of Hateful Speech Detection from General to Specific Types of Hate
articles.abstract: Harmful language detection is commonly evaluated on broadly defined hate speech and toxicity benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether models that successfully detect harmful language in general can transfer this capability to more specific forms of hate. We investigate this problem for misogyny detection in Polish, an area for which dedicated resources remain scarce. We introduce a new dataset of Polish social media comments annotated for misogyny, gender-directed hateful speech. Using this resource, we first assess the reliability of LLM-assisted annotation and then evaluate general-to-specific transfer by comparing models trained on general harmful language data, safety-specialized models, and models fine-tuned directly for misogyny detection. Our results show that strong performance on general harmful language detection does not transfer uniformly to misogyny; safety-specialized models demonstrate substantially stronger generalization ability. The study contributes a new Polish resource for gender-directed harmful language and demonstrates that the scope and granularity of prior safety training are important factors in transferring harmful language detection from general to specific forms of hate.
articles.titleCn: 波兰社交媒体中的厌女数据集：从通用类型到特定类型仇恨言论检测的迁移性
articles.abstractCn: 有害语言检测通常在广泛定义的仇恨言论和毒性基准上进行评估，但尚不清楚在一般领域成功检测有害语言的模型是否能够将这种能力迁移到更具体的仇恨形式。我们针对波兰语中的厌女检测问题进行了研究，该领域专用资源仍然稀缺。我们引入了一个标注了厌女和针对性别仇恨言论的波兰语社交媒体评论数据集。利用这一资源，我们首先评估了LLM辅助标注的可靠性，然后通过比较在一般有害语言数据上训练的模型、安全专业模型以及直接针对厌女检测进行微调的模型，评估了从一般到具体的迁移能力。我们的结果表明，在一般有害语言检测上的优异表现并不能均匀地迁移到厌女检测；安全专业模型表现出显著更强的泛化能力。这项研究贡献了一个新的波兰语性别导向的有害语言资源，并证明了先前安全训练的范围和粒度是影响有害语言检测从一般形式迁移到具体仇恨形式的重要因素。

articles.title: Offline-First Quantized AI: Design and Evaluation of an On-Device Maternal-Health Assistant for Low-Connectivity Environments
articles.abstract: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses, left 56 neutral, produced four adverse response changes, and left three pairs unassessable. RAG-on had descriptively higher mean usefulness, safety, correctness, and actionability in the conditional 70-pair subset excluding the four flagged pairs from both conditions. Physical-device testing demonstrated offline responses on a 6 GB Android handset, with a 14.3 s median latency, alongside successful reconnection synchronization in the integrated application. Together, the findings document clinical response quality and practical performance of the integrated offline maternal-health assistant.
articles.titleCn: 离线优先量化AI：低连接环境下设备端孕健康助手的设计与评估
articles.abstractCn: 离线语言模型可以在互联网连接不可靠的情况下扩展对孕产妇健康信息的获取，但其部署需要同时满足临床适宜的响应和可行的本地执行。本研究介绍了一种离线安卓助手，集成了现成的量化语言模型、临床验证的本地知识包、对话上下文以及模型触发的本地检索。Gemma 4 E2B和Qwen3.5 0.8B在45次对话和每配置312个回合中进行了比较，包括专门的离线代理基准测试。Gemma在响应质量、上下文保留和安全评分上表现更优；Qwen生成速度更快且内存使用更低。临床医生对150个Gemma响应在九个临床领域的评估显示，平均质量评分为3.80/4，其中147个响应符合接受标准。一项配对RAG（检索增强生成）开关实验评估了74个问题：检索改进了11个响应，留下56个中性响应，产生4个不良响应变化，留下3对无法评估。在排除两组中标记的4对后，RAG开启在70对条件子集中描述性地表现出更高的平均有用性、安全性、正确性和可操作性。物理设备测试在6 GB安卓手机上展示了离线响应，中位延迟为14.3秒，同时在集成应用中实现了成功的重新连接同步。综合来看，研究结果记录了集成离线孕产妇健康助手的临床响应质量和实际性能。

articles.title: The novelty exposed: ablation, reproducibility and transparency in 40 technical reports of open-weight large language models (LLMs)
articles.abstract: In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. We look at three things: what the reference code shows about how new open-weight architectures differ from earlier ones; what 40 randomly sampled technical reports claim as new and whether they support it with ablation studies; and what they disclose for reproducibility and transparency. In the library, 39 of the 48 architectures added in 2025 take at least two of their three core blocks from another model, most often Llama, although part of this reflects how the library writes code. In the reports, 19 of 73 architectural or training novelty claims come with a controlled with/without comparison; 4 of 40 reports state more than one training run; 8 rerun the models they compare against under one setup; and 1 discloses data mixture, token count, and compute together. We also looked for known components given new names: none of five candidate cases hid its origin, though we did not study model names. We propose seven reporting rules for LLM release reports and apply them to two reports. We do not judge model quality, and an untested claim may still be true.
articles.comment: Empirical study with an original dataset: 40 LLM technical reports coded by two independent model coders with script-verified quotes, plus a code-level comparison of open-weight architectures in Hugging Face transformers. 20 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Data, coding protocol and scripts in the ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 新发现的要点：在40份开放权重大型语言模型（LLMs）的技术报告中，展示了消融实验、可复现性和透明性。
articles.abstractCn: 仅在2025年，就有48种新的大型语言模型（LLM）架构被添加到Hugging Face的transformers库中，其中许多架构都附有技术报告，将模型描述为全新的。这些模型中真正新颖的地方是什么？它们是否经过测试？我们将这个问题投向了LLM技术报告。我们关注三个方面：参考代码展示了新开源权重架构与早期架构的不同之处；40份随机抽样的技术报告声称的新颖之处，以及它们是否通过消融研究来支持这些声明；以及它们在可复现性和透明度方面的披露。在库中，2025年添加的48种架构中有39种至少从其他模型中采用了其三个核心模块中的至少两个，其中最常见的是Llama，尽管部分原因反映了库的代码编写方式。在报告中，73项架构或训练新颖性声明中有19项附有受控的“有/无”比较；40份报告中有4份声明进行了多次训练运行；8份报告在相同设置下重新运行了它们比较的模型；1份报告披露了数据混合、令牌数量和计算量。我们还寻找了已知组件的新名称：在五个候选案例中，没有一个是隐藏其来源的，尽管我们没有研究模型名称。我们提出了七项针对LLM发布报告的报告规则，并将其应用于两份报告。我们不评判模型质量，未经测试的声明仍有可能为真。

articles.title: Anatomy of an Agent Harness: Decisions, Invariants and Corner Cases
articles.abstract: An agent harness is the program around a language model that turns its replies into actions: it builds each request, runs the tools the model asks for, decides what the model may do without asking, stores the conversation, recovers from failures, and shows a person what happened. Most of these decisions are made in code and rarely written down, so each harness meets the same corner cases again. This paper writes them down as invariants to test. It gives a system model with trust boundaries; 30 decision cards in six groups, each with options and costs, an invariant, the corner cases that break it, a test and an evidence tag; six cause classes for failures; a test method built on scripted providers, recorded behaviour and planted changes; and a checklist. The cards come from building one desktop harness, Crewroom, the author's own, and from manually testing ten other harnesses and studying open-source harnesses as reference; some patterns in the cards were adopted from those, so the catalogue is not independent of them. Of the 83 invariant clauses, 56 are tagged Tested, 12 Believed and 15 Open. The checklist is applied to the author's harness as one worked example, by its builder with no second rater: of its 30 items, 11 hold, 14 do not and 5 were not tested. It is not a ranking. The paper makes no claims about answer quality or cost or other platforms, and does not evaluate or rank other harnesses.
articles.titleCn: 代理框架的解剖：决策、不变量和边界情况
articles.abstractCn: 一个代理 harness 是围绕语言模型运行的程序，它将模型的回复转化为行动：构建每个请求、运行模型请求的工具、决定模型无需询问即可执行的操作、存储对话、从失败中恢复，并向用户展示发生的情况。这些决策大多在代码中完成且很少被记录下来，因此每个 harness 都会再次遇到相同的边界情况。本文将这些决策记录为不变式以进行测试。它提供了一个具有信任边界的系统模型；包含六个组共30个决策卡片，每张卡片都有选项、成本、不变式、会破坏不变式的边界情况、测试和证据标签；六个导致失败的起因类别；基于脚本提供者、记录行为和植入变更构建的测试方法；以及一个检查清单。这些卡片来源于构建一个桌面 harness Crewroom（作者自己的产品），并手动测试了十个其他 harness，同时参考了开源 harness；卡片中的某些模式借鉴了这些 harness，因此该目录并非独立于它们。在83个不变式条款中，56个被标记为已测试，12个为可信，15个为开放。检查清单被应用于作者自己的 harness 作为工作示例，由其构建者单方面执行，没有第二评价者：在其30个项目中有11项成立，14项不成立，5项未经过测试。这不是一个排名。本文不对答案质量、成本或其他平台做出任何声明，也不评估或排名其他 harness。

articles.title: Learning When to Continue and When to Stop: Termination-Aware OPSD
articles.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves language model reasoning by distilling from a frozen teacher initialized identically to the student and conditioned on privileged information. However, we identify an underexplored termination mismatch in OPSD: the student fails to reliably learn when to continue and when to stop. This mismatch manifests in two opposing failure modes-premature termination, where reasoning stops before sufficient progress is made, and repetition-driven over-generation, where the model continues generating after reasoning has stalled. Our analysis shows that the teacher-student discrepancy on EOS grows during OPSD training, while length-capped trajectories are frequently dominated by unproductive repetition. To address this issue, we propose TA-OPSD (Termination-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation), which augments the original OPSD objective with two targeted objectives. Stop/Continue Distillation addresses premature termination by explicitly aligning the teacher and student on whether reasoning should continue, while Repetition-Aware Unlikelihood Training addresses repetition-driven over-generation by discouraging repetitive continuations in the student's failed trajectories. The resulting objective improves termination behavior from complementary directions: continuing when further reasoning is needed and stopping when reasoning becomes unproductive. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks with Qwen3 (1.7B/4B/8B) show that TA-OPSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other baselines across all three model scales. Beyond the performance gains, ablation and behavioral analyses show that the two proposed objectives effectively mitigate their corresponding termination failures, reducing both premature termination and repetition-driven over-generation.
articles.titleCn: 学习何时继续和何时停止：具有终止感知的OPSD
articles.abstractCn: 策略内自我蒸馏（OPSD）通过从与学生初始化相同且基于特权信息的冻结教师模型中进行蒸馏，提升了语言模型的推理能力。然而，我们识别出OPSD中一个未被充分探索的终止不匹配问题：学生模型无法可靠地学习何时继续推理、何时停止。这种不匹配体现在两种相反的失效模式中——过早终止，即推理在取得足够进展前停止；以及由重复驱动的内容过度生成，即模型在推理停滞后继续生成。我们的分析表明，在OPSD训练过程中，教师与学生模型在结束符（EOS）上的差异会逐渐增大，而长度受限的轨迹中经常充斥着无益的重复。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TA-OPSD（终止感知策略内自我蒸馏），该方案在原始OPSD目标基础上增加了两个针对性目标。停止/继续蒸馏通过明确对齐教师与学生模型在推理是否应继续上的判断，来解决过早终止问题；而重复感知非似然训练则通过抑制学生模型在失败轨迹中的重复继续行为，来解决由重复驱动的内容过度生成问题。最终形成的优化目标从互补方向改进了终止行为：在需要进一步推理时继续，在推理变得无益时停止。在数学推理任务上使用Qwen3（1.7B/4B/8B）模型进行的实验表明，TA-OPSD在所有三种模型规模上都持续优于OPSD及其他基线模型。除了性能提升外，消融实验和行为分析表明，所提出的两个目标有效缓解了相应的终止失效问题，减少了过早终止和由重复驱动的内容过度生成现象。

articles.title: The Vocabulary Tax: Safely Trimming Unused Tokens from LLMs for On-Device Use
articles.abstract: Open large language models (LLMs) and speech models ship vocabularies of up to 262k tokens, and every user downloads the tables those tokens index (the input embedding, an untied output head and, in recent on-device models, per-layer embeddings), whatever languages they need. We call the bytes in rows a deployment never uses the vocabulary tax and measure it, without downloading weights, for 1,244 generative and speech-recognition models on the Hugging Face Hub. For a Thai and English deployment it is a median 4.4% of model bytes below 0.5B parameters and 2.1% above 8B, and 1.93 GB in Gemma 4 E2B: it falls hardest on the small models that edge devices run. Keeping only the rows of the deployment's writing systems is exact. Keeping the tokens seen in the user's own text removes much more, a median 29.0% below 0.5B, but the usual way of doing it breaks BPE tokenizers: it drops the intermediate tokens that merges build on, so new text is split differently 1.9 times as often as the standard check reports. We repair this with merge closure, at a cost of 5.9% more rows, and add a trim certificate: a Good-Turing estimate, from the trimming text alone, of how much new text the trimmed tokenizer will split differently (correlation 0.996 over 300 settings in 22 languages) and of how much more text a target needs. Without test data our method never exceeds a 2% target, while prior keep rules checked on test data exceed it in 9-13 of 44 settings. On six models of 270M to 3B parameters in 11 languages, trimmed models keep their predictions: where the certificate passes, a median 89.7% of rows is removed and bits per character rise by at most 2.0%. The census, the trimming and the certificate are released as an open Python package, and the per-model tax for 41 languages as an open dataset.
articles.titleCn: 词汇税：安全地从LLMs中移除未使用的标记以供设备使用
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和语音模型通常包含高达262k个token的词汇表，并且每个用户都会下载这些token索引的表格（输入嵌入、未绑定的输出头，以及最近在设备上的模型中每层嵌入），无论他们需要哪种语言。我们将部署从未使用的词汇表中的字节称为“词汇表税”，并在Hugging Face Hub上对1,244个生成和语音识别模型进行了测量，而无需下载权重。对于泰语和英语部署，在参数量低于0.5B的模型中，这是中位数4.4%的模型字节，在参数量高于8B的模型中，这是2.1%，在Gemma 4 E2B中为1.93GB：它对边缘设备运行的较小模型影响最大。仅保留部署书写系统的行是精确的。保留用户文本中出现的token可以去除更多内容，中位数低于0.5B的模型为29.0%，但通常的处理方式会破坏BPE分词器：它会丢弃合并构建所依赖的中间token，因此新文本被分割的频率是标准检查报告的1.9倍。我们通过合并闭包来修复这个问题，代价是增加了5.9%的行数，并添加了一个修剪证书：仅从修剪文本中估计修剪后的分词器将如何不同地分割新文本（在22种语言中300个设置的相关系数为0.996）以及目标需要多少更多文本。在没有测试数据的情况下，我们的方法永远不会超过2%的目标，而先前的保留规则在测试数据上检查的44个设置中有9-13个超过了这个目标。在11种语言中，参数量为270M到3B的六个模型上，修剪后的模型保持了它们的预测：在证书通过的情况下，中位数89.7%的行被移除，每个字符的字节数最多增加2.0%。人口普查、修剪和证书作为一个开源Python包发布，41种语言的每模型税作为一个开源数据集发布。

articles.title: Attribute or Abstain: Evaluating Evidence-Grounded Retrieval on the Low-Resource African Business Web
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems that research companies are judged by how much they find, yet in markets where public evidence is sparse, a confident answer without support costs more than no answer. We introduce AfriBizClaims, a benchmark of 150 company-research queries across six African markets in English, French and Portuguese, including queries about fictitious companies that a correct system must decline. Each claim a system makes is judged against the page it cites by an AI judge, checked against a second AI judge from another model family and against two human annotators, and abstentions are scored against answerability labels. We compare BM25 over a pooled corpus, standard web retrieval-augmented generation, and a multi-step agent pipeline (Konexium V1), all using the same language model. The two simple baselines are well attributed: 98% of their judged claims are supported by the page they cite, and they decline every field of every fictitious company. Counting claims about a company other than the one asked about as errors, the agent pipeline's per-query precision is 68%, and it never answers a question about a named company correctly: it substitutes other firms, including for 5 of the 24 fictitious names, and it is the least stable between runs and the most expensive. In the pipeline we evaluated, more steps between the query and the evidence did not buy more grounded answers. We will release the queries, system outputs, labels and short evidence excerpts.
articles.titleCn: 属性或弃权：评估基于证据检索的低资源非洲商业网络
articles.abstractCn: 研究公司评判其检索能力，但在公共证据稀疏的市场中，缺乏支持的自信回答比不回答成本更高。我们介绍了AfriBizClaims，这是一个包含150个跨六個非洲市场（英语、法语和葡萄牙语）的公司研究查询基准，其中包括关于虚构公司的查询，正确系统必须拒绝。系统提出的每个声明都由AI裁判根据其引用的页面进行评判，并与来自另一模型系列的第二个AI裁判以及两个人类标注员进行比对，而弃权则根据可回答性标签进行评分。我们比较了BM25在合并语料库上的表现、标准网络检索增强生成以及多步骤代理管道（Konexium V1），所有方法都使用相同的语言模型。这两个简单基线得到了很好的归因：98%的评判声明得到了其引用页面的支持，并且拒绝了所有虚构公司的所有领域。将询问的公司与所问公司不符的声明计为错误，代理管道的每查询精确率为68%，并且从未正确回答有关命名公司的查询：它用其他公司替代，包括5个24个虚构名称中的，并且它是运行间最不稳定且最昂贵的。在评估的管道中，查询和证据之间的更多步骤并未带来更可靠的答案。我们将发布查询、系统输出、标签和简短证据摘录。

articles.title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
articles.abstract: Looped language models such as Ouro and Raven apply one weight-shared block several times per token, so autoregressive decoding (AR) runs every loop of every token in sequence. Pipelined self-speculative decoders overlap these loops by drafting tokens from shallow readouts and verifying them at full depth. Yet every loop of a looped LM ends in a readout of the next token, and draft tokens pass through every depth anyway, so each depth can check them without an extra pass. We introduce LoopSkim, in which the depth of the pipeline is the verifier. Draft tokens copied from the context, as in prompt lookup decoding, enter after the first loops, any later readout that contradicts one replaces it at that depth, and only full-depth readouts commit tokens. LoopSkim fixes the random draws of every position in advance, so each check compares two tokens and decoding stays lossless in exact arithmetic under sampling for any number of checks and draft chains. Without training, its speedup over AR averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec across greedy decoding and sampling, and its checks between the first loops and full depth speed it up on every model. An optional draft head adds a second chain and raises this average to 1.99x.
articles.titleCn: LoopSkim：适用于循环语言模型的无损多深度推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型如Ouro和Raven对每个token多次应用权重共享的模块，因此自回归解码（AR）按顺序在每个token的每个循环中运行。流水线自推测解码器通过从浅层读取中提取token并在完整深度处验证它们来重叠这些循环。然而，循环语言模型的每个循环最终都以读取下一个token结束，草稿token无论如何都会通过每个深度，因此每个深度都可以在不进行额外遍历的情况下检查它们。我们引入了LoopSkim，其中流水线的深度是验证器。从上下文中复制的草稿token，如同提示查找解码，在第一个循环之后进入，任何后续的读取如果与之一致则替换它在该深度，只有完整深度的读取才会提交token。LoopSkim预先固定了每个位置的随机抽取，因此每个检查比较两个token，并且在采样下，解码在精确算术中保持无损，无论检查次数和草稿链的数量。在不进行训练的情况下，其相对于AR的速度提升平均为LoopSpec在贪婪解码和采样上的1.73倍，其在第一个循环和完整深度之间的检查加速了每个模型。可选的草稿头添加了第二个链，并将平均值提高到1.99倍。

articles.title: Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. The framework complements LLM-assisted grounded theory by exposing model dependencies before substantive interpretation. It assesses reliability and representational consequences, not interpretive validity or the quality of resulting theory.
articles.titleCn: 谁编写代码簿？审计LLM生成分类系统的八步框架
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地创造了解释定性证据的类别。现有的编码基准通常将这些类别固定。我们提出了定性差异审计框架，这是一种八步方法，通过在受控输入下比较编码簿创建、重复应用和编码分布来进行比较。它结合了模型拥有的编码簿和共享参考编码簿，以区分整体流程中的差异与在共同类别系统内的应用差异。对668次组织访谈、13,166个文本单元和五家供应商的八个模型的应用产生了48个编码簿和270次编码运行。模型创建了明显不同的类别结构；模型内平均可靠性范围在0.76至0.92之间，而共享编码簿的模型间一致性约为0.69。该框架通过在实质性解释之前揭示模型依赖性，补充了LLM辅助的扎根理论。它评估可靠性和代表性后果，而非解释效度或最终理论的质量。

articles.title: Bioformer-RetroMAE: retrieval-oriented pretraining of a compact biomedical language model for literature search
articles.abstract: Dense retrieval is increasingly used for biomedical literature search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Most biomedical bi-encoders are built on BERTBase-sized encoders pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM). These encoders are costly for corpus-scale indexing and latency-sensitive query encoding, and MLM does not explicitly train the [CLS] vector that a bi-encoder uses to represent a whole text. We present Bioformer-RetroMAE, a compact (43M-parameter) retrieval-oriented biomedical encoder obtained by continually pretraining Bioformer8L} with RetroMAE on approximately 32 million PubMed titles and abstracts. After bi-encoder fine-tuning with BM25 hard negatives, we evaluated it on BioASQ Task 12B test questions by retrieving from all PubMed abstracts. Bioformer-RetroMAE outperformed BioBERT and PubMedBERT bi-encoders fine-tuned under identical settings on all metrics, despite having about 40% of their parameters and producing 512-dimensional rather than 768-dimensional vectors. Compared with PubMedBERT, it improved mean average precision (MAP) by 37.0% and Recall@100 by 29.1%. Compared with the original Bioformer8L}, RetroMAE pretraining improved MAP by 53.6% and Recall@100 by 32.8% without changing model size or inference cost. In hybrid retrieval, fusing Bioformer-RetroMAE with BM25 through weighted reciprocal rank fusion improved MAP and NDCG@10 over BM25 alone by 4.9% and 4.6%, respectively, larger gains than those obtained by fusing BM25 with PubMedBERT or BioBERT.
articles.titleCn: Bioformer-RetroMAE：用于文献检索的紧凑型生物医学语言模型的检索导向预训练
articles.abstractCn: 密集检索在生物医学文献搜索和检索增强生成（RAG）中应用日益广泛。大多数生物医学双编码器基于BERTBase大小的编码器构建，这些编码器通过掩码语言模型（MLM）进行预训练。这些编码器在语料库规模的索引和延迟敏感的查询编码方面成本高昂，且MLM并未明确训练双编码器用于表示全文的[CLS]向量。我们提出了Bioformer-RetroMAE，这是一种紧凑型（4300万参数）的面向检索的生物医学编码器，通过在约3200万篇PubMed标题和摘要上持续使用RetroMAE对Bioformer8L进行预训练获得。在BM25硬负样本的双编码器微调后，我们在BioASQ Task 12B测试问题中从所有PubMed摘要中进行检索，评估了其性能。尽管Bioformer-RetroMAE的参数量约为BioBERT和PubMedBERT双编码器（在相同设置下微调）的40%，且生成的向量维度为512维而非768维，但在所有指标上均优于它们。与PubMedBERT相比，其平均精度均值（MAP）提高了37.0%，Recall@100提高了29.1%。与原始Bioformer8L相比，RetroMAE预训练使MAP提高了53.6%，Recall@100提高了32.8%，且未改变模型大小或推理成本。在混合检索中，通过加权递归秩融合将Bioformer-RetroMAE与BM25结合，使MAP和NDCG@10分别比单独使用BM25提高了4.9%和4.6%，这一提升幅度大于将BM25与PubMedBERT或BioBERT结合所获得的提升。

articles.title: Bridging the Terminology Gap: A Data-Centric Alignment Framework for Multilingual Translation in Cross-Border Corporation
articles.abstract: As globalization accelerates the demand for seamless cross-border enterprise collaboration, multilingual translation remains bottlenecked by insufficient domain-specific terminology, rigid terminology translation, weak instruction-following capabilities, and high inference latency in long-instruction scenarios. To overcome these barriers, we propose Bridging the Terminology Gap (BTG), a data-centric framework. First, BTG mines cross-lingual term alignments from domain documents and leverages LLMs to synthesize terminology-rich parallel corpora. Second, a hybrid filtering strategy combining heuristics and XCOMET scoring ensures high data fidelity. Third, a two-stage training paradigm employs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for targeted terminology injection, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) to refine output preferences, effectively balancing domain knowledge integration with model reliability. Extensive offline evaluations (e.g., XCOMET, GEMBA, Acc@T) and online human assessments demonstrate significant improvements in terminology accuracy and instruction-following capabilities, validating the effectiveness of our framework, which is now deployed on our cross-border collaboration platform.
articles.titleCn: 弥合术语鸿沟：跨境公司多语言翻译的数据中心对齐框架
articles.abstractCn: 随着全球化加速跨境企业协作的需求，多语言翻译仍受限于专业领域术语不足、术语翻译僵化、指令遵循能力弱以及长指令场景中推理延迟高等问题。为克服这些障碍，我们提出了以数据为中心的术语鸿沟弥合（BTG）框架。首先，BTG从领域文档中挖掘跨语言术语对齐，并利用大语言模型合成富含术语的平行语料库。其次，采用结合启发式方法和XCOMET评分的混合过滤策略，确保数据高保真度。第三，采用两阶段训练范式，先通过监督微调（SFT）进行目标术语注入，再通过强化学习（RL）优化输出偏好，有效平衡领域知识整合与模型可靠性。大量离线评估（如XCOMET、GEMBA、Acc@T）及在线人工评估显示，术语准确性和指令遵循能力显著提升，验证了该框架的有效性，现已部署于我们的跨境协作平台。

articles.title: NoLBERT-Calls: Reading Earnings Calls Without Hindsight
articles.abstract: Language models are now a standard tool for measuring what managers say on earnings calls, but the encoders behind these measures were usually pretrained on text from the same years a backtest covers. Holding out a test period does not remove that hindsight, because it sits in the features. We adapt NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on text published between 1976 and 1995, to earnings calls without letting it read anything dated after 31 December 2023. The calls supply the training signal themselves: every analyst question is followed by management's answer, and the model learns to pick that answer out from the other answers of the same call. We test on every US call from January 2025 to October 2026 (20,323 calls, 254,575 questions) and make every modeling choice on calls from 2024. The adapted model, NoLBERT-Calls-2023, ranks the true answer first for 78.0% of questions (95% interval 77.8-78.2; chance 8.0%), against 26.3% before adaptation. It is 1.0 point ahead of a call-adapted ChronoBERT, 3.4 points ahead of a call-adapted FinBERT, and 18.7 and 19.8 points ahead of the best off-the-shelf retriever and BM25. A year-by-year test over 2013-2026 finds no look-ahead premium: relative to a model adapted only through 2012, the released model does no better on the years it was trained on than on years it never saw. The price of the cutoff is compute: under one shared 150-minute recipe NoLBERT adapts least well of four encoders, and its lead comes from a longer, staged adaptation of about 13 GPU-hours.
articles.titleCn: NoLBERT-Calls：没有后见之明地阅读财报电话会议
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型现已成为衡量管理层在财报电话会议中发言的标准工具，但这些衡量指标的编码器通常是在与回测覆盖年份相同的文本上预训练的。保留测试期并不能消除这种后见之明，因为它存在于特征中。我们调整了NoLBERT，这是一个仅在1976年至1995年间发布的文本上预训练的编码器，并将其应用于财报电话会议，同时不让它读取2023年12月31日之后的任何信息。电话会议本身提供了训练信号：每个分析师的问题后面都跟着管理层的回答，模型学习从同一电话会议的其他回答中挑选出正确的答案。我们在2025年1月至2026年10月的所有美国电话会议（20,323次会议，254,575个问题）上进行测试，并在2024年的电话会议上做出所有建模选择。调整后的模型NoLBERT-Calls-2023对78.0%的问题（95%置信区间77.8-78.2；随机概率8.0%）将正确答案排在首位，而调整前仅为26.3%。它在电话会议调整的ChronoBERT上领先1.0分，在电话会议调整的FinBERT上领先3.4分，并且比最佳现成检索器和BM25分别领先18.7分和19.8分。一项2013年至2026年的逐年测试发现没有前瞻性溢价：相对于仅在2012年之前进行调整的模型，发布的模型在它所训练的年份上表现并不优于它从未见过的年份。这种截止日期的成本是计算资源：在共享的150分钟配方下，NoLBERT是四个编码器中适应性最差的，它的领先优势来自于约13个GPU小时的更长时间、分阶段的调整。

articles.title: A phase diagram for training and inference in language models
articles.abstract: A language model is a complex system whose behavior is determined jointly by the Transformer and the corpus, yet how the representation geometry in the Transformer relates to the actual behavior of language models remains open. We analyze how the representation geometry changes along the forward propagation of actual language models and characterize the representation geometry of a document at a given layer by two collective coordinates, document distinguishability and document dimension. On the phase diagram spanned by these collective coordinates, inference is represented as a flow along depth. We find that, for untrained models, depending on their initialization scale, most of the 156 inference flows move toward the collapse and noise regions of the phase diagram. By contrast, the inference flows of 8 trained models from 5 architecture families all enter and reside in the central region of the phase diagram. Describing the evolution of the flows with a discrete Langevin equation, we find that the difference between the inference flows of untrained runs and those of trained models reduces to whether the effective force on the flows in this region is of saddle or stable-node type. On Pythia-1.4B, we interpret the training process as a phase transition. These results give a unified gateway to the relation between representation geometry and language-model behavior.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型训练与推理的阶段图
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型是一个由Transformer和语料库共同决定的复杂系统，然而Transformer中的表示几何如何与语言模型的实际行为相关联仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们分析了实际语言模型在正向传播过程中表示几何的变化，并通过两个集体坐标——文档可区分性和文档维度——来表征给定层中文档的表示几何。在这些集体坐标构成的相图上，推理被表示为沿深度的流动。我们发现，对于未训练的模型，根据其初始化规模，大多数156条推理流动都朝向相图中的坍缩区和噪声区移动。相比之下，来自5个架构系列的8个训练模型的推理流动都进入并驻留在相图的核心区域。通过用离散朗之万方程描述流动的演化，我们发现未训练运行与训练模型的推理流动之间的差异归结于该区域中流动的有效力是鞍点类型还是稳定节点类型。在Pythia-1.4B上，我们将训练过程解释为相变。这些结果为表示几何与语言模型行为之间的关系提供了一个统一的入口。

articles.title: Grounding Language Models in Speech Does Not Fix "AI Flavor": Calibrated LLM Judges, Goodhart Traps, and a Preference-Tuning Fix
articles.abstract: Chinese outputs of large language models carry a perceptible "AI flavor": formulaic sentence frames, stacked written-register connectives, repetition loops, and layout leakage. A popular hypothesis blames text-only training for the missing inner-speech layer of human writing; injecting speech or prosody signals should therefore reduce it. We test it with controlled interventions on a 0.6B model; all three fail: (i) phoneme-interleaved continued pretraining yields no spokenness gain under text-matched controls while raising repetition (+0.13 [+0.03, +0.23]); (ii) prosody-plan conditional generation reaches an adherence of only 0.257 against a pre-registered 0.50 gate; (iii) a rule-based reward built on TTS prosody-feature distance is imperceptible in double-blind evaluation by both humans (8/16) and a calibrated LLM judge (9/16). A root cause is evaluation: single-rater blind evaluation at n~20 only detects extreme (>=85%) preferences. We therefore build a calibrated LLM-judge protocol: the judge passes catch trials on known-answer pairs (16/16; single-text 22/24, same-topic pairs 24/24, versus 0.75 for the human rater), then annotates with two independent judges under A/B swapping, counting disagreement as a tie. Using the judge's agree labels directly as DPO pairs (no reward model), we obtain the first positive result: held-out blind win rate 0.833 [0.699, 0.972], repetition 0.114 to 0.000, unchanged MMLU. We further identify a Goodhart channel: the judge's length preference transduces into output-length collapse via pairwise DPO (median 75 chars vs a 300-char prompt); an SFT-anchor repairs it (w is a style knob: w=0.1 preserves gains, w=0.3 does not). Scaling preference data from 89 to 240 pairs yields no additional judge-visible gain. We release RA-Eval v0.1: a three-layer Chinese AI-flavor evaluation framework with 382 judge-annotated preference pairs.

articles.titleCn: 将语言模型与语音相结合并不能解决“AI味道”问题：校准的大型语言模型评判者、Goodhart陷阱以及偏好微调的解决方案
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的中文输出带有明显的“AI味道”：公式化的句子框架、堆砌的书面语连接词、重复循环以及布局泄露。一个流行的假设将文本训练归咎于人类写作缺失的内部语音层；因此，注入语音或韵律信号应该能减少这种现象。我们通过在0.6B模型上实施受控干预来验证这一假设；所有三种方法均失败：(i) 音素交错持续预训练在文本匹配对照下并未提升口语化程度，反而增加了重复性（+0.13 [+0.03, +0.23]）；(ii) 韵律计划条件生成对预设的0.50门控的遵循度仅为0.257；(iii) 基于TTS韵律特征距离的规则化奖励在双盲评估中既未被人类（8/16）也未被校准的大型语言模型裁判（9/16）感知到。根本原因在于评估：n~20的单评人盲评估仅能检测到极端（>=85%）的偏好。因此，我们构建了一个校准的大型语言模型裁判协议：裁判在已知答案对上通过测试（16/16；单文本22/24，同主题对24/24，而人类裁判为0.75），然后在A/B交换下由两名独立裁判标注，将分歧计为平局。直接使用裁判的同意标签作为DPO对（无奖励模型），我们首次获得积极结果：保留盲胜率0.833 [0.699, 0.972]，重复性从0.114降至0.000，MMLU不变。我们进一步识别出一个Goodhart通道：裁判的长度偏好通过成对DPO转化为输出长度崩溃（中位数75字符对比300字符的提示）；一个SFT锚点可以修复它（w是一个风格旋钮：w=0.1保留收益，w=0.3则不）。将偏好数据从89对扩展到240对并未带来额外的裁判可见收益。我们发布了RA-Eval v0.1：一个包含382个裁判标注的偏好对的中文AI味道评估框架，共三层。

articles.title: EfficientSkill: Learning Skills for Token-Efficient Multi-Turn Agents
articles.abstract: Reflective skill optimizers improve multi-turn LLM agents by revising instructions from failed and successful rollouts, yet accumulating edge-case rules bloats prompts, inflates token use, and pushes agents into long, error-prone loops. We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost. Across four frontier, mid-tier, and open-weight models on MATH-500, ALFWorld, and SpreadsheetBench, EfficientSkill cuts output tokens over unconstrained EvoSkill on 11 of 12 configurations (by up to 80%) while raising mean accuracy on every benchmark, including +14.3 and +17.5 percentage-point gains on SpreadsheetBench with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast by replacing stalled loops with compact workflows. By shrinking both generated tokens and replayed history, EfficientSkill lowers total token usage and serving cost across every evaluated configuration, with or without full-prefix KV caching.
articles.titleCn: 高效技能：为令牌高效的多轮代理学习技能
articles.abstractCn: 反思技能优化器通过修订失败和成功执行过程中的指令来改进多轮大语言模型代理，但累积边缘案例规则会导致提示膨胀、令牌使用增加，并使代理陷入冗长且易出错的循环。我们引入了高效技能（EfficientSkill）框架，该框架首先在不产生令牌惩罚的情况下发现可靠技能，然后从该技能开始进行带精度保护的修剪，以压缩指令、限制代理轮次，并将可重用代码卸载到工作区工具中，且无需任何实现提示成本。在MATH-500、ALFWorld和SpreadsheetBench上的四个前沿、中端和开放权重模型中，EfficientSkill在12种配置中的11种（最高达80%）比无约束的EvoSkill减少了输出令牌，同时在所有基准测试中都提高了平均准确率，包括使用Gemini 3.8 Flash和Grok 4.1 Fast替换停滞循环为紧凑工作流时，在SpreadsheetBench上分别提升了14.3和17.5个百分点。通过减少生成的令牌和重放的回放历史，EfficientSkill降低了在所有评估配置中的总令牌使用量和服务成本，无论是否使用完整前缀KV缓存。

articles.title: Machine interpreting competitiveness: a discourse-sensitive comparison of meaning and target-language quality in English-Chinese simultaneous interpreting
articles.abstract: Machine interpreting (MI), or AI-enabled speech translation, is increasingly visible in professional and public-facing communication, yet its performance relative to human simultaneous interpreters remains insufficiently understood. Existing studies are often limited by a single discourse mode and evaluation frameworks that are not well aligned with interpreting as a discourse-level communicative activity. The present study compares five commercial MI systems with 26 human interpreters (14 professionals, 12 advanced students) on English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpreting across planned and unplanned discourse, focusing on meaning and target-language quality. In these materials, MI performance differed sharply between the two discourse modes. In the planned formal speech, the strongest system became highly competitive on meaning, entering the upper human range, and a second system also performed strongly. In the extemporaneous interview, however, no MI system approached the stronger human tiers. Code-level analysis further shows that similar overall scores often masked different error profiles. Human interpreters were more likely to preserve the broader communicative trajectory through selective omission, restructuring, and contextual inference, whereas even the best MI systems were more vulnerable to semantic distortion, discourse-tracking failures, and context-insensitive interpretation. On target-language quality, the human advantage proved more stable than on meaning. Unintelligible or nonsensical output and disfluency carryover emerge as particularly salient weaknesses in machine performance, especially in spontaneous discourse. Overall, the findings are consistent with a discourse-sensitive account of where MI appears competitive, where it remains limited, and why these distinctions matter for interpreting practice, interpreter education, and future MI development.
