articles.titleCn: 机器翻译竞争力：英汉同声传译中意义与目标语言质量的语篇敏感比较
articles.abstractCn: 机器口译（MI），即人工智能赋能的语音翻译，在专业和面向公众的交流中日益凸显，但其相对于人类同声传译员的表现仍缺乏充分理解。现有研究往往受限于单一话语模式和与口译作为话语层级交际活动不完全匹配的评估框架。本研究将五种商业MI系统与26名人类同声传译员（14名专业人士，12名高级学员）在计划性和非计划性话语中的英译中同声传译表现进行对比，重点关注意义和目标语言质量。在这些材料中，MI在不同话语模式下的表现差异显著。在计划性正式演讲中，最强系统在意义上表现出高度竞争力，进入人类表现的上限范围，第二系统也表现出色。然而，在即兴访谈中，没有MI系统接近较强人类水平。代码级分析进一步显示，相似的整体分数往往掩盖了不同的错误特征。人类传译员更可能通过选择性省略、重组和语境推理来保留更广泛的交际轨迹，而即使是最好的MI系统也更容易受到语义扭曲、话语追踪失败和语境不敏感解读的影响。在目标语言质量方面，人类优势比在意义上更为稳定。无法理解或无意义的输出和流畅性遗留问题成为机器表现中尤为突出的弱点，尤其是在自发话语中。总体而言，研究结果与话语敏感的视角一致，揭示了MI在哪些方面具有竞争力、哪些方面存在局限，以及这些差异为何对口译实践、传译员教育和未来MI发展具有重要意义。

articles.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
articles.abstract: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine that exploits branch grouping and shared-cache reuse. Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss. These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU. Ablation studies show that branching yields gains beyond changes in width and depth, enables an effective KV-sharing strategy (Joint-KV), remains robust across fusion functions, and performs best in the middle layers. These findings show that branching offers a practical path for scaling language models toward both better modeling quality and faster inference.
articles.titleCn: 多分支Transformer
articles.abstractCn: Transformer语言模型通常通过增加块宽度或堆叠更多层来扩展。在这项工作中，我们探索了一条替代路径：分支，即全Transformer块的并行组合。我们引入了多分支Transformer（MBT），它通过共享的初始层处理输入，并行执行独立参数化的顺序块分支，并在共享的最终层之前融合它们的输出。在可比的训练计算量下，我们研究了三种MBT变体：宽浅型保持块宽度，窄深型保持顺序深度，平衡型则在两者之间进行插值。在四个专家混合比例（0.8B至2.1B总参数）的受控预训练实验中，2分支宽浅型MBT始终在匹配参数和训练计算预算下优于顺序Transformer。平衡型MBT进一步提升了性能，并随着分支数量的增加保持相当的质量。为提高长上下文推理效率，我们引入了联合KV，它从每层深度处的分支表示构建共享的KV缓存。我们的最终方案结合了平衡型MBT与联合KV，并由一个利用分支分组和共享缓存重用的推理引擎支持。拟合的扩展曲线表明，标准Transformer需要高达1.26倍的训练主体计算量才能匹配我们最终模型的验证损失。这些模型将全模型KV缓存存储减少了高达34%，并在单个H200 GPU上实现了高达51.4%的更高解码吞吐量。消融研究表明，分支带来的收益超越了宽度和深度的变化，实现了有效的KV共享策略（联合KV），在各种融合函数中保持稳健，并在中间层表现最佳。这些发现表明，分支为扩展语言模型提供了实用路径，既能提升建模质量，又能加快推理速度。

articles.title: Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice
articles.abstract: Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work directions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdomains. Each query presents a research goal, hypotheses tested with key results, and two candidate future directions: one author-recommended direction and one plausible distractor sampled from a similar paper. Across eight LLMs, author alignment ranges from 45.0% to 67.5%, while stable divergence ranges from 15.0% to 36.2%. These divergences largely persist under similarity controls, prompt ablations, and an author-preference framing check, and inter-model agreement suggests that some non-author preferences are shared across models. We characterize what models diverge toward using transition-category labels and selected reasoning examples, finding recurring movement toward scaling/generalization and trade-offs between methodological and infrastructure/data extensions. We view this as an early descriptive evaluation for eliciting research taste profiles in LLMs, and as a step toward understanding and steering their research preferences as they take on more autonomous roles in novel open-ended scientific discovery.
articles.comment: Accepted at the LM4Sci Workshop at COLM 2026. 23 pages, 7 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Lossfunk/research-taste-eval-v1
articles.titleCn: 通过未来研究方向选择激发大语言模型的研究兴趣
articles.abstractCn: 在人工智能科学家群体中，研究品味正日益受到讨论，但在大型语言模型中却鲜有研究或测量。这一判断在开放式研究中尤为重要，因为在获得可验证目标之前必须选择研究方向。我们通过科学工作流程中的一个任务来操作化研究品味：在给定研究目标和当前结果的情况下，选择要追求的未来研究方向。我们并非预测下游科学计量指标或将作者的选择视为客观正确，而是将模型与人类撰写的未来工作方向进行评估，并报告作者一致性、稳定分歧和不稳定选择，以此作为研究偏好行为指标。我们构建了一个受顺序控制的评估，涵盖了2025年12月至2026年2月间在四个子领域发表的19篇机器学习论文中的80对比较。每个查询都呈现一个研究目标、用关键结果验证的假设，以及两个候选未来方向：一个是作者推荐的方向，另一个是从相似论文中采样的合理干扰项。在八个大型语言模型中，作者一致性范围在45.0%至67.5%，稳定分歧范围在15.0%至36.2%。这些分歧在很大程度上在相似性控制、提示消融和作者偏好框架检查下仍然存在，而模型间的一致性表明某些非作者偏好在不同模型中是共享的。我们使用过渡类别标签和选定的推理示例来描述模型分歧的方向，发现反复出现向扩展/泛化移动的趋势，以及方法论扩展与基础设施/数据扩展之间的权衡。我们视此为一种早期描述性评估，旨在提取大型语言模型中的研究品味特征，并作为理解和引导其研究偏好的第一步，随着它们在新型开放式科学发现中承担更多自主角色。

articles.title: Logical AI OS: A Training-Free Governance Layer Outside the Model for Instruction Following -- Benefits, Costs, Failures, and the Calibration of the Measuring Instrument Itself
articles.abstract: Small language models often fail explicit user requests (length, number of items, format, required or forbidden words, grammatical person, answer language). We measure a training-free governance layer placed outside the model: it reads the requests with rules, checks the answer mechanically, repairs it when a request is not kept, and hands back the original answer when the repair fails. The loop exists in prior work; our contribution is measuring its benefits, costs and failures, and reporting how the measuring instrument itself was calibrated. On four 4-bit Qwen-family models (3B, 7B, 14B, one 7B reasoning model) and 329 Chinese prompts: (1) answers that keep every request the layer read rise significantly (all comparisons p<0.0001), by 34 to 66 of 329 under the corrected checker and 52 to 92 after a length-control fix; a generic redo message brings no significant gain. (2) Exploratory: on 90 repair-triggered prompts, two AI annotators found the layer produced an acceptable answer where the bare model did not more often than the reverse (49:7; 18:12, not significant). (3) Costs: 43-66% more generation time; whole-answer rewriting makes a sizeable share of usable answers unusable. (4) Failures: rule-based reading reaches about 70% and 84% of a two-annotator ceiling on unseen phrasings; unsatisfiable requests make the reasoning model loop; model self-reports are unreliable (18 of 25 "fixed" items were not fixed). (5) Over half of the original checker's "violated" verdicts on structural requests were wrong; after correction the main result holds, and one comparison is downgraded. Conclusions are limited to this Chinese material, the Qwen family and sizes up to 14B. The governance implementation is not released; data, answers, verdicts and the checker are public.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. Technical report v3. Earlier reports in this line: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23226740 (Measurement Layer) and the Validation Layer report. Data, model answers, per-item verdicts, annotations and the standalone checker: https://github.com/blackwing04/Logical-AI-OS (tag v3.0-data). The governance-layer implementation is not released
articles.titleCn: 逻辑AI操作系统：模型外部用于指令遵循的无训练治理层——效益、成本、失败以及测量工具本身的校准
articles.abstractCn: 小型语言模型常在明确用户请求（长度、数量、格式、必须或禁止的词语、语法人称、回答语言）方面失败。我们测量了一个置于模型外部的无训练治理层：它读取带规则的请求，机械地检查答案，在请求未被满足时修复答案，并在修复失败时返回原始答案。该循环在先前工作中已存在；我们的贡献在于测量其收益、成本和失败，并报告测量工具本身的校准方法。在四个4位Qwen系列模型（3B、7B、14B、一个7B推理模型）和329个中文提示下：（1）保持所有读取请求的答案显著提高（所有比较p<0.0001），在修正检查器下有34到66个329个答案，在长度控制修复后有52到92个答案；通用的重做信息没有显著提升。（2）探索性：在90个触发修复的提示中，两个AI标注员发现该层产生的可接受答案比基础模型更频繁（49:7；18:12，不显著）。（3）成本：生成时间增加43-66%；整句重写使相当一部分可用答案变得不可用。（4）失败：基于规则的读取达到两个标注者对未知短语天花板约70%和84%；无法满足的请求使推理模型陷入循环；模型自报信息不可靠（25个“修复”项中有18项未被修复）。（5）超过一半原始检查器对结构请求的“违规”裁决是错误的；修正后主要结果仍然成立，一个比较结果被降级。结论仅限于这些中文材料、Qwen系列和14B大小。治理实现未公开；数据、答案、裁决和检查器是公开的。

articles.title: Ambiguous Examples Help, But Full Data Wins: Revisiting Dataset Cartography for Extractive Adversarial QA
articles.abstract: Dataset cartography argues that training dynamics can reveal regions of a dataset that matter differently for learning: easy-to-learn examples aid optimization, hard-to-learn examples often expose annotation problems, and ambiguous examples contribute strongly to out-of-distribution generalization. A striking implication of the original work is that a model trained on only 33% ambiguous examples can outperform full-data training on several OOD evaluations, including a QNLI reformulation of SQuAD evaluated on Adversarial SQuAD. We revisit this claim in a stricter setting: open-ended extractive question answering, where models must predict answer spans rather than classify question-sentence pairs. For each encoder family, we compute clean-source SQuAD training dynamics, train on full, random, easy-ranked, ambiguous-ranked, and hard-ranked subsets, and evaluate robustness on adversarial-only AddSent and AddOneSent rows. Ambiguous-ranked 33% subsets beat random 33% subsets on exact-match accuracy in all 14 model-evaluation cells and on F1 in 12/14 cells. However, full-data training beats ambiguous-ranked training in 12/14 exact-match cells and 12/14 F1 cells, with mean full-minus-ambiguous gains of 3.40 EM and 4.10 F1. The most thoroughly replicated ELECTRA-small panel is also the main exception to the ambiguous-over-random F1 gains. These results show that clean-source cartography remains useful for reduced-data selection, but its OOD advantage does not carry over as a general replacement for full-data training in extractive adversarial QA.
articles.comment: 37 pages, 30 figures, 20 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027. Code: https://github.com/PaulKMandal/dataset-cartography-qa
articles.titleCn: 模糊示例有所帮助，但完整数据胜出：重新审视用于抽取式对抗问答的数据集地图绘制
articles.abstractCn: 数据集制图学认为，训练动态可以揭示数据集中对学习起不同作用的部分：易于学习的样本有助于优化，难于学习的样本常常暴露标注问题，而模糊样本则对分布外泛化有显著贡献。原始工作的一个突出启示是，仅使用33%的模糊样本训练的模型，在多个分布外评估中可以优于全数据训练，包括在对抗性SQuAD上评估的SQuAD QNLI重述。我们在更严格的设置中重新审视这一主张：开放式抽取式问答，其中模型必须预测答案跨度而不是分类问句-句子对。对于每个编码器家族，我们计算干净源SQuAD训练动态，在完整、随机、易学习排序、模糊排序和难学习排序的子集上训练，并在对抗性AddSent和AddOneSent行上评估鲁棒性。模糊排序的33%子集在所有14个模型评估单元中的精确匹配准确率上优于随机33%子集，并在12/14个单元中的F1上占优。然而，全数据训练在12/14个精确匹配单元和12/14个F1单元中优于模糊排序训练，平均全数据减模糊数据的增益为3.40 EM和4.10 F1。最彻底复制的ELECTRA-small面板也是模糊排序优于随机排序F1增益的主要例外。这些结果表明，干净源制图学对于减少数据选择仍然有用，但其分布外优势并不能作为全数据训练的通用替代方案，在抽取式对抗性问答中。

articles.title: StaleBench: Isolating Stale Retrieval in Agent Memory, and Pricing the Fix
articles.abstract: An agent that stores facts over time eventually stores several versions of the same fact. Asked a value-agnostic question - "which team does X play for now?" - a similarity retriever cannot prefer the current version, because every version matches the entity the query names. StaleBench isolates this stale-retrieval failure on 892 real updating facts, with currency labels from the source (Wikidata validity years via TempLAMA), never from a retrieval score. Our central result is that retrieval metrics can rank memory policies backwards: a retention policy and its retain-everything control return the identical statement at rank 1 for every test query, yet differ by 29.5 and 65.6 points in reader accuracy on two readers when no date is shown. Contamination@5, the metric we add, ranks them correctly where current@1 and current@5 do not. Withdrawing the lexical anchor that statements carry costs deployed keying mechanisms tens of points of freshness; entity resolution on both the write path and the query recovers most of the loss. Three deployed systems (Mem0, Graphiti, LangMem) and a reimplemented ERASE each handle supersession differently, and no single scoring convention describes all four. We release the data, a frozen evaluator, and reference baselines.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 39 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/thenexuslab/stalebench-release
articles.titleCn: StaleBench：隔离代理记忆中的过时检索，并评估修复成本
articles.abstractCn: 一个随时间存储事实的代理最终会存储同一事实的多个版本。当被问到一个与值无关的问题——“X现在效力于哪个球队？”——相似度检索器无法优先选择当前版本，因为每个版本都与查询中提到的实体相匹配。StaleBench通过892个真实的更新事实（通过TempLAMA获取源中的货币标签，即Wikidata的有效年份），而非检索分数，隔离了这种过时检索失败的情况。我们的核心结果是检索指标可以反向排序记忆策略：保留策略及其“保留所有”的控制策略在所有测试查询中都返回相同的陈述作为排名第一的结果，但在未显示日期的情况下，在两个读者上的阅读准确率上分别相差29.5和65.6分。我们新增的指标Contamination@5正确地对他们进行了排序，而current@1和current@5则没有。移除陈述所携带的词汇锚点成本使部署的关键机制新鲜度降低了数十分；在写入路径和查询上的实体解析恢复了大部分损失。三个部署系统（Mem0、Graphiti、LangMem）以及重新实现的ERASE对失效处理方式各不相同，没有单一的评分规范可以描述所有四种情况。我们发布了数据、一个冻结的评估器和参考基线。

articles.title: Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both
articles.abstract: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.
articles.titleCn: 在测试时，LLM代理应该在哪些方面进行适应？是在上下文中，还是在权重中，或两者皆是？
articles.abstractCn: 在相同环境中反复运行的LLM代理，例如代码仓库、数据库或应用程序套件，会遇到具有潜在结构的任务。经验可以揭示这种结构，使代理能够重用环境知识并从环境反馈中学习。代理可以通过两个渠道在测试时利用这种经验：将其保留在上下文中以及更新其权重。这些渠道通常被单独研究，导致不清楚每个渠道的贡献以及它们何时相互补充。我们使用共享在线协议和模块化框架，单独和组合比较了上下文学习（ICL）、使用GRPO的可验证奖励强化学习和使用SDPO的自蒸馏。代理遇到匹配的任务流，在适应每个任务之前都会在每个任务上进行评估，并且仅从自己的尝试和环境反馈中学习。我们在SWE-bench验证、AppWorld、ScienceWorld和BIRD-Critic-SQLite四个环境中抽取的109个任务上，使用每个环境五个任务顺序，评估了14种适应机制和具有Qwen3.5-9B的无状态基线。ICL提供了最大的独立增益：其最佳策略将跨环境的平均成功率从28.8%提高到49.4%。向该策略添加GRPO实现了最高的平均成功率，达到51.6%。虽然添加GRPO在每种ICL策略下都提高了整体平均成功率，但SDPO的效果则较为复杂。跟踪分析显示，在ICL下查找次数更少且尝试时间更短，这与重用共享结构的知识一致。然而，ICL也频繁跳过当前任务的检查和验证。向ICL添加GRPO有助于恢复这些行为，同时保留其减少的环境查找。这些观察结果表明，具有可验证奖励的强化学习可以改进代理如何使用保留的经验，从而促使对上下文管理和权重更新的联合研究。

articles.title: Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining
articles.abstract: Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. Because historical contribution, an understandable explanation, and future data value require distinct evidence, we specify a feedback loop that interprets attributed sources, tests candidate data changes, and states for five claim types what evidence each requires and what none establishes. We close with a falsifiable comparison against perplexity, classifier, and mixing baselines at equal total compute.
articles.comment: Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance (ATTRIB 2026) at NeurIPS 2026, Idea Track. 4 pages main text, 13 pages total, 1 figure, 2 tables
articles.titleCn: 数据归因应指导预训练
articles.abstractCn: 预训练数据管理决定了模型学习的内容，然而，一个文档是否值得学习取决于模型已有的知识。受影响驱动的选择器已经通过排序文档来提升单次运行效果；我们主张，训练数据归因应通过识别可测试的数据属性来引导预训练，这些属性可成为可重复使用的管理标准，并在新数据上使用成本更低的选器进行评估，包含发现成本在内，以匹配总成本。一个文档排名仅被其计算所对应的运行所消耗，而一个解释了的数据属性可以在不同语料库和检查点之间进行测试，尤其是在熟悉的质量信号与测量的有用性出现差异时。由于历史贡献、可理解的解释和未来数据价值需要不同的证据，我们指定了一个反馈循环，该循环解释归因来源、测试候选数据变更，并针对五种声明类型说明每种证据所需的内容以及何种证据无法成立。最后，我们在总计算成本相等的条件下，与困惑度、分类器和混合基线进行了可证伪的比较。

articles.title: MathaMAGICal: Validating Trajectory Data Attribution During Capability Acquisition
articles.abstract: Influence-function-based methods like MAGIC provide exact first-order scores for trajectory data attribution, yet only retraining indicates whether those scores accurately predict data removal. We evaluate MAGIC on $86$M- and $152$M-parameter GPT-2-style models learning multistep arithmetic from scratch on filtered web text and four synthetic math families. Full-run attribution at $86$M suffers from numerical overflow, and even with metagradient clipping, scores correlate near chance with retraining (linear datamodeling score, LDS, $0.17$--$0.22$). In contrast, short checkpoint windows yield stable, accurate predictions at both scales (LDS $0.86$--$0.99$ across four $100$-step windows at $152$M), whereas a single-checkpoint gradient-dot baseline shows near-zero correlation. Rankings of individual training blocks predict retraining only within that single run and do not transfer across seeds or hyperparameters ($ρ\le 0.09$), whereas format-level patterns replicate across runs. Two data families, worked examples and primitive facts, occupy $2.1$--$2.6\times$ their corpus share in both the helpful and harmful $5\%$ score tails, reflecting strong bidirectional local sensitivity distinct from net benefit under multi-epoch family deletion. These results show that trajectory attribution is reliable within short, validated windows and yields family-level insights that generalize across runs.
articles.titleCn: MathaMAGICal：验证能力获取过程中的轨迹数据归属
articles.abstractCn: 基于影响函数的方法（如MAGIC）为轨迹数据归因提供了精确的一阶分数，但只有重新训练才能表明这些分数是否准确预测了数据移除。我们在参数为$86$M和$152$M的GPT-2风格模型上评估了MAGIC，这些模型从过滤的网页文本和四个合成数学家族中学习多步算术。在$86$M参数模型上，完整运行归因存在数值溢出问题，即使使用元梯度裁剪，分数与重新训练的相关性接近随机水平（线性数据建模分数LDS为$0.17$--$0.22$）。相比之下，短检查点窗口在两个规模下都产生了稳定、准确的预测（在$152$M参数的四个100步窗口中，LDS为$0.86$--$0.99$），而单检查点梯度点基线的相关性接近零。单个训练块的排名仅在单次运行内预测重新训练，且无法迁移到不同的种子或超参数（$ρ\le 0.09$），而格式级别的模式则能在多次运行中重复出现。两个数据家族——示例和基本事实——在有益和有害的5%分数尾部中占其语料库份额的$2.1$--$2.6$倍，反映了与多周期家族删除下的净收益不同的强双向局部敏感性。这些结果表明，在短且经过验证的窗口内，轨迹归因是可靠的，并能提供跨运行泛化的家族级洞察。
